resolvedDefect: An authoritative account-not-found response is no longer required to share the same error class as a network outage; TS and Go expose exact, fail-closed categories.
integrationNotes: ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND requires an account lookup plus an exact semantic 404; a generic route 404 remains HTTP_ERROR.
The CLI and Go example now consume the Go SDK probe rather than maintaining divergent response logic.
The source-bound read-only probes requested only eth_chainId and proved exact 0x1917 when the endpoint was reachable.
The earlier curl timeout remains recorded as a timeout and is not promoted to a successful connection.
